maddeler.e:
تراضيت (form VI)
# تَرَاضَيْتُ (tarāḍaytu) /ta.raː.dˤaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَرَاضَى (tarāḍā)
# تَرَاضَيْتَ (tarāḍayta) /ta.raː.dˤaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَرَاضَى (tarāḍā)
# تَرَاضَيْتِ (tarāḍayti) /ta.raː.dˤaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَرَاضَى (tarāḍā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
